descriptionChirho: The gentilic adjective designating members of the Levitical clan descended from Gershon son of Levi, used substantively as a collective or individual identifier. All three clusters are grammatical variants of the same clan designation with article and preposition variation: 'the Gershonite/to the Gershonite' (eng the-Gershonite, spa el-gersonita/los-gersonitas, hin गेरशोनी-के, arb الجِيرْشُونِيّ, kor 그-게르손-인, swa Wagershuni), 'the Gershonites' with article (eng the-Gershunite, spa el-gersonita, hin गेर्शुन्नी-के, arb الْجَرْشُونِيِّ, kor 그-게르심-사람의, swa Mgershoni), and a final variant 'the Gershuni' (eng the-Gershuni, spa los-gersonitas, hin गेर्शोनी-के, arb الْجِرْشُونِيِّينَ, kor 그-게르손의, swa Wagershoni). All translations uniformly render a single clan identity.
